install_tell: SaaS; SDK package lakera-chainguard / lakera-llm-vulnerability-scanner; bearer token Authorization header
misconfig_patterns: Customer-side API key leakage in client-side SPA bundles or public GitHub repos: lak_ prefix tokens grant prompt-injection scan quota; verify-do-not-exercise.
Self-hosted appliance (self-hosted.docs.lakera.ai surfaces) is documented but population is dark to public Shodan; cert-pivot via lakera.ai operator CN is the discovery move.

response_markers: messages, or tools must be provided
active_probe.false_positive_check: 400 body MUST cite docs.lakera.ai/docs/api; status-code-alone is identity not auth-state

deployment_tells: Cloudflare-fronted SaaS apex (api.lakera.ai, eu-west-1.api.lakera.ai, us-east-1.api.lakera.ai, ap-southeast-1.api.lakera.ai)
Internal eu-west-1-internal / us-east-1-internal / ap-southeast-1-internal subdomains resolve to private AWS space (RFC1918-adjacent / VPC) -- DNS-only exposure, not a surface
litellm-eu.lakera.ai, litellm-us.lakera.ai indicate LiteLLM in the inference path
gandalf.lakera.ai = public prompt-injection challenge product; distinct surface from Guard
pivot_paths: POST /v2/guard -- returns marker error string with docs URL; fingerprint anchor, no auth needed for status read
ssl.cert.subject.cn pivot on lakera.ai for operator attribution including embedded customers
sources: LiteLLM litellm/proxy/guardrails/guardrail_hooks/lakera_ai.py + lakera_ai_v2.py (2026-06-07, Slice D delta read)

litellm_v1_vs_v2_delta.verdict: Same vendor, same SaaS host (api.lakera.ai), same env var (LAKERA_API_KEY), same network fingerprint. v2 is a NEW endpoint + new capabilities, not a new platform. One tome entry covers both; passive enumeration cannot distinguish v1-using from v2-using operators.

v2.scope: chat completions ONLY (/v1/chat/completions); NOT supported for Responses API, /v1/messages, MCP, A2A per source comments
v2.request_shape: messages + payload/breakdown booleans; response includes masked-entity count and per-message modifications array

litellm_v1_vs_v2_delta.operator_choice_signal: v2 is the newer surface and the documented direction; operators still on v1 are either legacy (older LiteLLM) or have a non-chat-completions use case. The v1-vs-v2 split is a TEMPORAL signal at the operator config layer, not at the network layer.
added_surface_v2_over_v1: PII masking pipeline (payload=true) creates a mapping in LiteLLM memory between original and masked tokens; same in-memory de-anonymization risk pattern as Presidio wrapper.
breakdown=true returns per-detector results; an attacker who can read guardrail responses learns Lakera's detector taxonomy on every call, which informs evasion.
litellm_v1_vs_v2_delta.tome_separate_entry_decision: NO. v2 is an endpoint + parameter delta on the same SaaS, same auth, same network fingerprint. One platform entry, dual endpoint coverage.
